idea: Four focused hours of deep work routinely outproduce ten hours of shallow, reactive work.
application: When a task is cognitively heavy (design, hard debugging, interview prep), schedule it in a dedicated 90–120 minute block before any reactive work.

idea: Don't live with broken windows — fix small defects immediately or promise to fix them visibly.
application: If a capture mentions buggy code without urgency, suggest a scheduled fix task (not_urgent_important) rather than dropping it.

idea: Make it easy: reduce the friction of good habits by preparing the environment in advance.
application: When the user plans a recurring practice (LeetCode drills, morning review), suggest pre-staging: open problems the night before, one-click setup.
